description: Rebuild Wallet screen with real Supabase data and clean UI. Remove all fake balances, fake transactions. Connect to real wallets and transactions tables. Implement clean minimal design matching reference style.
steps: Rewrite app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/ui/screens/wallet/WalletScreen.kt: Remove all hardcoded balances (15234.50), fake transaction lists, and fake statistics. Implement clean white UI with: balance card showing real available_balance from Supabase 'wallets' table, pending balance (escrow_balance), total earnings. Transaction list from 'transactions' table. Loading/empty/error states. Filter tabs (All, Income, Expense, Pending). Each transaction shows: icon, title, date, amount, status badge. Clean card style (no gradient/glass).

Update app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/ui/viewmodel/WalletViewModel.kt: Remove mock data from all fallback paths. Load wallet from Supabase 'wallets' table where user_id = current auth user. Load transactions from 'transactions' table where user_id = current auth user, ordered by created_at DESC. Expose proper loading/error/empty states. The deposit and withdraw actions should perform real Supabase operations.

Update app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/repository/WalletRepository.kt: Remove all mock data in catch blocks. Fetch wallet from 'wallets' where user_id matches. Fetch transactions from 'transactions' where user_id matches. Return proper errors instead of fake data. Use the authenticated user's ID from the current session.
Ensure Add Money and Withdraw dialogs perform real operations via Supabase (inserting into deposits/withdrawals tables with proper fields matching schema.sql).
acceptance_criteria: WalletScreen shows real balance from Supabase wallets table - no hardcoded values
Transactions list comes from Supabase transactions table - no fake entries
Proper loading state shown while fetching
Proper empty state when no wallet/transactions exist
Proper error state on network failure (user-friendly message, no Supabase URLs)
Add Money creates a real deposit request in Supabase
Withdraw creates a real withdrawal request in Supabase
Clean white UI with minimal cards, no glass/gradient effects
verification: Run ./gradlew assembleDebug and confirm build passes
findings: Wallet screen fully rewritten with real Supabase data. WalletRepository: fetches from 'wallets' and 'transactions' tables using auth user ID, deposits to 'deposits' table, withdrawals to 'withdrawals' table, no mock data fallbacks. Defined WalletFullDto (with escrow_balance, currency fields beyond the WalletDto in UserRepository). WalletViewModel: no-arg constructor, uses viewModel() pattern, exposes single WalletUiState with loading/error/success states. WalletScreen: clean white card design, balance card (available/pending/total earnings), filter tabs (All/Income/Expense/Pending), real transaction list with type-based icons and status badges, Add Money and Withdraw dialogs with real Supabase operations. All hardcoded values removed (15234.50, #RX12345, Premium account type, fake transactions). Build cannot be verified in sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY) but code follows existing patterns exactly.
